justifications.B_COUPLE/EPS_REC: stability solved analytically over mu(W) in [-1,1] (graph-independent); among stable+oscillatory settings, chosen to make P3 -- a COMPETITOR arm -- strongest on dev (b=0.60 gave P3 top1 0.000, i.e. broken)
justifications.KC_PHASE: NOT swept -- left at its drafted value. Sweeping the hypothesis arm upward would be the biased direction.
justifications.MARGIN/MERGE_MARGIN/CONTAM_MARGIN: separate thresholds in their own units; merges are counts, contamination is quantised in steps of 1/TOPK
justifications.PHASE_SUBSTEPS: frozen at a CONVERGED value (10), not at the 4-substep transient where P4 scores highest; a stopping time is not a mechanism
justifications.REACH_DEPTH: swept on dev; purity 0.781/0.787/0.752/0.724 for depth 1/2/3/4; chosen to maximise P2, again a competitor arm
